# Delivery: how the words are said

How a script says its words are said, in three forms that differ only in how much they cover: `[words]{terms}` the bracketed words, `<!-- delivery: terms -->` a stretch (the paragraph under it, eased in and out; inline, from that word; exactly up to a `<!-- /delivery -->`), and a note's own named delivery (`<!-- delivery: giddy = excited, speeding up -->`). Terms are comma-separated, each a delivery below, an act, a shape, or an axis given a number (`rate 1.2`, `pitch +3st`, `volume -6dB`, `rate 1..1.4` a ramp), with a degree word before or after it or a number (0-2) after it.

DeliveryBank - the vocabulary a script says HOW its words are said in (next/delivery.md), and what it makes of a stretch of them. One vocabulary, three forms that differ only in how much they cover: `[words]{terms}` the words in the brackets (`Manuscript.DELIVERED`, read as a closed stretch round them), `<!-- delivery: terms -->` a stretch (to its paragraph's end, or to `<!-- /delivery -->`), and the terms themselves comma-separated.

A term is a delivery of `BANK` (an expression, a word for one axis, a ramp), an act of `ACTS` on the stretch's last word (or every word, for `none`, `hit` and `spaced`), a shape of `SHAPES` over the stretch, or an axis of `AXES` given a number (`rate 1.2`, `pitch +3st`, `volume -6dB`, `rate 1..1.4` a ramp). Any of them takes a degree: a word of `DEGREES` before or after it, or a number after it (0-2). A bank row is written in these same terms, so a row is a list of axis values, and a note may name its own (`<!-- delivery: giddy = excited, speeding up -->`).

Degree 1 is clearly that, as a good reader would give it: about half of what an actor gives it in the acted corpora (`extremely`, 2, is the acted size). Semitones and dB scale with the degree, multipliers by its power.

Pure: `parse` reads terms, `resolve` lays a passage's stretches over its tokens - every token's axis values (`x`) and acts (`acts`) as the voice host reads them (hosts/voice/inflection.py, piper.py).

Rows: `DeliveryBank` in [src/voice/delivery_bank.gd](../src/voice/delivery_bank.gd) (128 deliveries, 17 acts, 4 shapes, 15 axes). The plan and its sources: [next/delivery.md](../next/delivery.md).

## Axes

| Axis | Unit | Limits | What it moves |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rate` | x | 0.5 to 2.0 | How fast the words go, as a multiplier on the voice's own pace. |
| `pauses` | x | 0.05 to 3.0 | How long every rest in the stretch is, as a multiplier over the four kinds below: its commas, its sentence and paragraph ends, its hesitations. |
| `commas` | x | 0.05 to 4.0 | How long the rests at commas, semicolons and colons inside a sentence are, as a multiplier on the voice's own Pause at them. |
| `ends` | x | 0.05 to 4.0 | How long the rest after a sentence's end is, as a multiplier on the voice's own Pause at sentence ends. |
| `paragraphs` | x | 0.05 to 4.0 | How long the rest after a paragraph's end is, as a multiplier on the voice's own Pause at paragraph ends. |
| `hesitations` | x | 0.0 to 4.0 | How long a marked hesitation (<!-- hesitation -->) in the stretch is, as a multiplier on the voice's own Hesitate: near 0 takes it out. |
| `pitch` | st | -8.0 to 14.0 | The register, in semitones up or down, moved inside the model so the speaker keeps their size. |
| `range` | x | 0.02 to 3.0 | How far the pitch swings about its running mean, as a multiplier: 0 is a monotone, 2 twice as lively. Scales the inflections too. |
| `volume` | dB | -20.0 to 8.0 | The level in the mix, in dB, eased in and out and never into the clip. |
| `effort` | - | -1.0 to 1.0 | The spectral tilt of a tense (up to 1) or lax (down to -1) voice, the level kept. |
| `push` | - | -1.0 to 1.0 | The pressed voice of the model's own style space: 1 is two of its readers' standard deviations along it. |
| `breath` | - | -1.0 to 1.0 | The breathy voice of the model's own style space: 1 is three of its readers' standard deviations along it. |
| `whisper` | - | 0.0 to 1.0 | How much of the voice is breath in place of its voicing: 1 a whisper. |
| `tremor` | - | 0.0 to 1.0 | A shaking voice: 1 is +-0.8 semitones and +-3 dB at about six a second, its rate wandering. |
| `precision` | - | -1.0 to 1.0 | Consonants held longer (crisp, up to 1) or shorter (slurred, down to -1). |

## Shapes

| Shape | What it does | Also |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `building` | From nothing at the stretch's start to all of it at its end: crescendo, poco a poco. | building up, gradually, growing, poco a poco |
| `fading` | From all of it at the stretch's start to nothing at its end: diminuendo. | fading out, easing off |
| `swelling` | From nothing to all of it three fifths of the way, and back to nothing. | swell |
| `sudden` | All of it from the first word, eased neither in nor out: subito. | suddenly, subito, all at once |

## Acts on a word

| Act | What it does | Also |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rise` | A question's rise by the word's end, whatever the sentence is (H-H%). | rising end, question |
| `low rise` | Low, then a rise at the very end: a polite or tentative question (L* H-H%). | tentative |
| `fall` | A full fall to the floor: final and certain, a question said as a statement (H* L-L%). | falling end, final |
| `rise-fall` | Up then down across the stressed vowel: impressed, insisting. | rise fall |
| `fall-rise` | Down then up: a reservation, an implied but. | fall rise |
| `contrast` | A dip, then a steep rise onto the stressed vowel and a fall: this one, not that one (L+H*). | correction, contrastive |
| `scoop` | Low on the stressed vowel, rising late in the word: doubt, incredulity (L*+H). | incredulous, doubting |
| `reminder` | A step down onto the stressed vowel: as we know (H+!H*). | as we know |
| `held` | Level from the stressed vowel on, no fall: not finished, a list, suspense. | level, suspended, hanging |
| `chant` | Two levels held, high then a step lower: a name called across a room. | calling contour, sing-song call |
| `drawn` | The word's last vowel and what sounds after it held a third of a second more, its pitch a gentle hill (up, then down): searching, suspense, savoring. | drawn out, elongated, stretched, lengthened, prolonged |
| `clipped` | The word's last sound cut short, no trail: curt. | curt |
| `cut off` | The word stops at its first vowel's end, as if interrupted. | broken off, interrupted |
| `spaced` | Every word hit and slowed, crisp: ab-so-lute-ly. (every word) | marcato, each syllable |
| `none` | No accent and no rise the text would give: as plain as the voice says it. (every word) | no inflection, uninflected |
| `hit` | Stressed as an italic word is: higher at its stressed vowel, held longer, a little louder. (every word) | stressed, emphasized, leaned on |
| `hit hard` | Stressed as a bold word is, the hardest of the two. (every word) | strongly stressed |
